subject: Closure orbit: commit inventory + forecast gaps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0000
Subject: Closure orbit: commit inventory + forecast gaps

Morning team —

We're at T-minus 48 hours for the quarter close. Quick, practical ask: I need each owner to do a light-pass on their committed deals and update the tracker (attached template) by EOD today. Focus on three things only:

- Confirm: is this deal 100% committed this quarter? (yes/no)
- Stage change: if not, what stage will it land in and why (procurement, legal, billing)?
- Gap & action: one-sentence blocker + owner + ETA (e.g., PO pending, Lauren Hayes / 12/17)

I attached a blank commit_tracker_template.csv to keep entries consistent. We'll consolidate into a single rollup at 09:30 tomorrow for exec visibility. If you believe a commit is optimistic, flag it — we want accuracy over hopeful optimism.

Priority deals: D-18742 (AstraHealth), D-18399, D-19021 — call these out explicitly in your update.

Deliverable: updated tracker row(s) + a 1-line confirmation email if you have any material changes.

Thanks —
Jonas
VP Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: commit_tracker_template.csv (CSV, 5kb)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:03:24 -0000
Subject: Re: Closure orbit: commit inventory + forecast gaps

On Tue, 14 Dec 2026 at 08:12, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Morning team —
> 
> We're at T-minus 48 hours for the quarter close. Quick, practical ask: I need each owner to do a light-pass on their committed deals and update the tracker (attached template) by EOD today. Focus on three things only: ...

Thanks for the clear ask. I updated rows for D-18742 and D-19021 in my local tracker. Summary below: 

- D-18742 (AstraHealth): moving to COMMIT PENDING PO. Procurement confirmed intent; PO estimated 12/17. I attached my export: commit_tracker_marissa.xlsx.
- D-19021: legal redline resolved, finance sign-off received, will slip to billing queue 12/16 — marking as COMMIT.
- D-18399: still in discovery with product questions, marking as STAGE: procurement.

Action: I'll drop the attached export into the shared Drive folder after I sync with Lauren (AstraHealth) at 10:00 PT. If anything changes, I'll send a 1-line update.

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: commit_tracker_marissa.xlsx (XLSX, 42kb)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 10:10:45 -0000
Subject: Re: Closure orbit: commit inventory + forecast gaps

Jonas / team —

Thanks. Two quick governance notes from Finance / RevOps: 

1) For any deal marked COMMIT PENDING PO, we need the expected PO date + the procurement contact and a screenshot of procurement confirmation (email thread accepted). Without that, we have to carry the amount as "probable" rather than "committed."

2) For D-18742 specifically: procurement told Marissa they intend to issue a PO but procurement sign-off from their CFO is required. If the PO date slips beyond 12/17, we should move it to next quarter's forecast.

I attached the PO_guidance.pdf that outlines what we require for commit recognition. Please make sure rows include the required evidence fields.

If any AE wants me to escalate on the procurement call now, say so and I'll jump in.

— Priyom
Senior RevOps Manager
Attachment: PO_guidance.pdf (PDF, 78kb)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Hayes <l.hayes@astrahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 11:15:02 -0000
Subject: Re: Closure orbit: commit inventory + forecast gaps

Thanks all — quick summary and next steps for the rollcall: 

- Marissa: D-18742 = COMMIT PENDING PO (ETA 12/17). Please paste Lauren's procurement confirmation line into the tracker row and upload the thread screenshot.
- Marissa: D-19021 = COMMIT — accept as committed for the rollup.
- Priyom: finance guidance noted; we'll default to conservative recognition if evidence is not in the tracker by EOD.
- All AEs: update the tracker by 18:00 PT today. We'll do a 09:30 standup tomorrow to lock the rollup for leadership reporting.

Lauren — looping you directly so your procurement contact is aware of the PO timing. If you prefer we escalate internally from our side, let us know and Priyom will join the call.

I'll consolidate entries into the master Drive link and send the 09:30 rollup email.

Jonas
VP Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://drive.redwood.ai/commit-tracker/D-18742
